title: Problem
问题
html:
N-gram decontamination misses training examples that solve the same task with different wording or code. A benchmark score can therefore mix out-of-distribution reasoning with exposure to test-like data, even when no string duplicate is present.

The paper searches an open training corpus for semantic duplicates, then uses controlled fine-tuning to test whether them improve both matched items and held-out items from the same benchmark. It frames this benchmark-specific spillover as shallow generalization.

基于 n-gram 的去污染会漏掉题意或计算任务相同、措辞或代码不同的训练样本。即使没有字符串重复，基准分数仍可能同时反映分布外推理与对测试式数据的接触，因而夸大能力进展。

论文在开放训练语料中检索语义重复，再用受控微调检验它们是否同时提高匹配题和同一基准中未见题的表现；作者把这种只在基准内部扩散的提升称为浅层泛化，并非一般能力增长。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Soft contamination is semantic task overlap, not text overlap. The authors embed sampled Olmo3 pretraining data and all three instruction datasets, label high-similarity pairs, and fine-tune Olmo3 on exact or synthetic semantic duplicates. The central result is that duplicate exposure can improve held-out items from the same benchmark without usually transferring to related benchmarks. Thus a benchmark gain can be shallow within-benchmark generalization. The contribution is an audit method and code, not a released training dataset.
软污染是语义任务重合，不是文本重合。作者嵌入抽样的 Olmo3 预训练数据和全部三类指令数据，对高相似度配对标注，再用精确或合成语义重复微调 Olmo3。核心结果是：重复暴露会提高同一基准的未见题，却通常不迁移到相关基准，因此榜单增益可能只是基准内浅层泛化。贡献是审计方法与代码，不是公开训练数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select open-data setting. The study uses Olmo3-7B so corpus exposure can be inspected; it uses MBPP, CodeForces, MuSR, and ZebraLogic.
  1. Retrieve candidate overlap. It embeds 1% stratified samples of Dolma3/Dolmino plus all Dolci SFT, DPO, and RL data with llama-embed-nemotron-8b, then ranks corpus--benchmark pairs by cosine similarity.
  1. Label duplicates. Top or sampled top-0.1% pairs are manually or Gemini-labeled as exact, equivalent, subset, superset, related, or unrelated. Cosine similarity is only a retrieval signal, not the acceptance verifier.
  1. Build controlled duplicates. The authors generate task-preserving paraphrases, alternate code, or altered narratives/grids; MBPP solutions are run against tests. They fine-tune with LoRA and compare seen, held-out same-benchmark, and related-benchmark performance.
  1. Test realistic dosage. A 10k clean MuSR SFT set is compared with the same set after replacing 5% by 500 semantic duplicates. Reproduction requires corpus snapshots, embedding model, labeling prompt, generators, LoRA settings, and benchmark versions; closed-corpus exposure is unknown.

1. 选择开放数据设置：使用 Olmo3-7B 以检查语料暴露，并选 MBPP、CodeForces、MuSR、ZebraLogic。
  1. 检索候选重合：以 llama-embed-nemotron-8b 嵌入 Dolma3/Dolmino 的分层 1% 样本及全部 Dolci SFT、DPO、RL 数据，按 cosine similarity 排序。
  1. 标注重复：对最高或 top-0.1% 抽样配对人工或用 Gemini 标为精确、等价、子集、超集、相关或无关；相似度只是召回信号，不是接受 verifier。
  1. 构造受控重复：生成保任务的改写、替代代码或改造叙事/逻辑格；MBPP 代码经测试验证。以 LoRA 微调，并比较见过题、同基准未见题与相关基准。
  1. 测现实剂量：在 10k 干净 MuSR SFT 集中用 500 条语义重复替换 5%。复现需固定语料快照、嵌入模型、标注提示、生成器、LoRA 和基准版本；闭源语料暴露未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The key causal test mixes 500 level-2/3 MuSR semantic duplicates into a 10,000-example SFT set and compares it with the same clean set. Table 5 reports Olmo3 contaminated fine-tuning at 66.4 on seen MuSR items and 54.4 on unseen items, versus clean fine-tuning at 50.0 and 48.8; TrueDetective remains 28.0. This supports benchmark-specific transfer from realistic duplicate exposure, but the unseen gain is modest and Qwen3 replication is noisy. Corpus analysis finds semantic duplicates for 78% of CodeForces tasks and exact duplicates for 50% of ZebraLogic tasks; those rates apply to this inspected Olmo3 corpus, not all models.

关键因果实验把 500 条 MuSR 二、三级语义重复混入 10,000 条 SFT 数据，并与同一干净数据比较。表 5 中，Olmo3 污染微调在见过题为 66.4、未见题为 54.4；干净微调为 50.0、48.8，相关 TrueDetective 均为 28.0。这支持现实重复暴露产生基准特异迁移，但未见题增益较小，Qwen3 复现也有噪声。语料分析另发现 78% CodeForces 有语义重复、50% ZebraLogic 有精确重复；比例只适用于被检查的 Olmo3 语料，不能外推所有模型。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior contamination work chiefly asks whether exposure improves the same item or detects string overlap. This paper tests whether duplicates of one subset improve held-out items in the same benchmark, then contrasts related benchmarks. Its novelty is the operational claim of shallow generalization, supported by realistic-dose fine-tuning and open-corpus semantic search. Embeddings only retrieve candidates; labels and controlled duplicates provide the decision evidence.
既有污染研究主要问暴露是否提高同一题，或检测字符串重合。本文改为检验：一部分题的重复是否提高同基准的保留题，再与相关基准对照。新意是把浅层泛化变成可操作主张，并以现实剂量微调和开放语料语义检索支撑。嵌入只用于召回候选，真正的判定证据来自标注和受控生成重复。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper likely underestimates soft contamination: semantic retrieval has false negatives, Dolma contains relatively few synthetic rephrasings, and RL-environment data is not covered. It studies an open-data model, whereas frontier corpora are larger and unavailable; their duplicate rate cannot be inferred from Olmo3. The realistic-dose MuSR result strongly supports seen-item effects but gives mixed evidence for held-out transfer, and Qwen3 is noisy. Report retrieval recall, labeling error, corpus snapshot, and the clean-versus-contaminated split rather than treating a cosine score or one model as proof of ecosystem-wide contamination.
论文可能低估软污染：语义检索有假阴性，Dolma 中合成改写较少，也未覆盖 RL 环境数据。研究对象是开放数据模型，前沿语料更大且不可见，不能由 Olmo3 推断其重复率。MuSR 现实剂量实验强力支持见过题效应，却对未见题迁移提供混合证据，Qwen3 也有噪声。复用时应报告检索召回、标注误差、语料快照和干净/污染切分，不能把 cosine 分数或单一模型当成全生态污染证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work to audit an open training corpus before trusting a reasoning benchmark. Given a benchmark, corpus snapshot, embedding model, and annotator budget, retrieve high-similarity pairs, label task equivalence, and report exact/semantic overlap with uncertainty. To test impact, construct validated duplicates of one benchmark split and compare seen, held-out, and external items with a matched clean fine-tune. Do not use cosine similarity alone as a filter or treat n-gram removal as proof of OOD evaluation.
在信任推理基准前，可用本工作审计开放训练语料：给定基准、语料快照、嵌入模型和标注预算，召回高相似配对、判断任务等价，并带不确定性报告精确/语义重合。要测试影响时，只对一部分基准构造经验证的重复，并与匹配的干净微调比较见过题、未见题和外部题。不能单靠 cosine similarity 过滤，也不能把去除 n-gram 当作分布外评测证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Problem: semantic rather than n-gram overlap can make a benchmark measure shallow generalization.
  1. Method: retrieve with embeddings, label duplicate type, then use controlled duplicate fine-tuning; similarity is not the verifier.
  1. Scope: 1% sampled Dolma3/Dolmino plus all three Dolci instruction datasets, using open-data Olmo3-7B.
  1. Evidence: Table 5 gives contaminated Olmo3 66.4/54.4 seen/unseen MuSR versus clean 50.0/48.8; TrueDetective is unchanged at 28.0.
  1. Decision: audit task equivalence and transfer to an external benchmark before treating a gain as broad reasoning progress.

1. 定位：语义而非 n-gram 重合会让基准测到浅层泛化。
  1. 方法：先嵌入召回、再标注重复类型，最后受控重复微调；相似度不是 verifier。
  1. 范围：使用 Dolma3/Dolmino 的 1% 样本与全部三类 Dolci 指令数据，基础模型为开放数据 Olmo3-7B。
  1. 证据：表 5 的污染 Olmo3 在 MuSR 见过/未见题为 66.4/54.4，干净组为 50.0/48.8；TrueDetective 均为 28.0。
  1. 决策：接受广泛推理进展前，先审计任务等价性并检查能否迁移到外部基准。
